mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and with it being a clear night, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:17 AM as it travels from the northwest over Verona High School toward the east northeast. Our overnight low will reach 70 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center has announced that they will be replacing flooring throughout their building beginning September 1. This will cause temporary schedule changes through September 11, including a closure on Labor Day, though they will host an open house on September 10.

There are several ways to stay active in Verona. You can head to Insight Wellness for yoga today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of options, including trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market.
In our weekly police report, on August 28, a motor vehicle collision occurred on South Nine Mound Road near Paoli Street, resulting in a citation for inattentive driving.
Today's flavor is the delicious Turtle Dove. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
